evolvability: VALIDATOR-V1-EVOLVABLE (CON §8: 'License carry (SPDX field) FROZEN; validator version EVOLVABLE'). The manifest license FIELD is frozen; this ids-only allowlist is the v1 validator data and may grow in later 1.0.x/minor releases without breaking authored manifests. Validation is EXACT-MATCH against this list — expressions, OR-duo ('(MIT OR Apache-2.0)'), and '+' suffixes are v1-out-of-scope and refused.
source: ids-only vendored subset of the SPDX License List (https://spdx.org/licenses/) bounded to licenses common in vendored upstream projects; NOT the full SPDX corpus
